description: This is a promotional advertisement for an AI video editing application called Slot Studio. The narrator, identified as YouTuber Siddharth Dev who creates long-form fitness content, claims you no longer need a human video editor. He demonstrates that by typing a single prompt ('Make an ad for yourself'), the tool automatically edits his videos. The demo shows the software importing his raw clips and voiceover, then performing tasks: searching YouTube for specific shots (e.g., 'barbell row side view'), scanning long videos to extract only the needed 4-second segments in 4K, cleaning voiceover by removing breaths, ums, and repeated starts without clipping words, and then applying full post-production including sound design, word-by-word captions, motion graphics, 3D charts, glass-tier lists, and style matching. It also shows copying an editing style from an Instagram Reel and applying it to his own clips, and connecting external AI models for image/video generation. The app is said to install on a Mac, connect to Claude, require no subscription ($0/month), learn from user corrections via a RULES.md file, and provide free lifetime upgrades. The video ends with a call-to-action to comment 'EDITOR' to receive a link.
